summary: Batch #24 (Auto-Link Invites + Role Editing + Resend Invite) verified end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_batch24_preview_claim_role.py. GET /api/families/preview: valid code -> 200 with family_name + 4 pending members carrying member_id/name/relationship/role/photo_url/color/is_child (unlinked only); invalid code -> 404; lowercase code normalised. POST /api/families/join with claim_member_id: valid pending id -> 200 and admin/joiner /families/me shows SAME count (5) with the claimed member owning is_me=true + joined=true for the joiner (name Priya preserved); claim_member_id=null path -> +1 new member; claiming already-linked admin id -> 400; unknown id -> 400. PATCH /api/families/members/{id} role: child (is_child=true), adult (is_child=false), parent (is_child=false) all -> 200; role='grandparent' -> 400; targeting the family admin -> 403; joined non-admin child cannot PATCH others -> 403. Frontend (390x844 web preview, fresh admin+<uuid>@fam.com + POST /api/seed/demo, fresh joiner+<uuid>@fam.com): onboarding Join flow renders 'Join a family' -> invite code -> 'Continue' -> 'Which one is you?' screen listing Priya/Aarav/Anaya/Meera + "I'm a new member" (4 pending profile chips + 1 new-member chip); selecting Priya + 'Join Family' claims her — admin /families/me count stays at 5 (no duplicate), joiner /families/me shows is_me on Priya with joined=true and name preserved; Home header renders 'Good Morning, Priya' and Family tab shows Priya as Joined. Admin role editing: Manage -> tap Priya's badge -> actions modal shows Role chips (Parent/Child/Adult) + Resend Invite section (Invite via WhatsApp + Share invite link) + Remove from family for a PENDING member; tapping Child persists (API confirms role=child, is_child=true); closing and reopening the modal shows Child chip pre-selected (brand border rgb(255,107,107) vs transparent on the others); tapping Adult persists (role=adult, is_child=false). For a JOINED non-admin member, resend buttons are correctly HIDDEN and only Remove remains — Remove -> confirm -> member disappears (6->5). No React Native deprecated packages detected. No red screens; only the pre-existing 'Share is not supported in this browser' web-only LogBox from RN-Web Share.share fires when tapping 'Share invite link' on web, which was already reported in iteration_21 and is expected outside iOS/Android.
action_items: No new action items for this batch. The pre-existing 'Share invite link' RN-Web unhandled-promise LogBox (see iteration_21 rca) still applies to the resend-share button in family.tsx; harmless on native, but wrapping the onPress in try/catch (or adding a web-only Clipboard fallback inside invite.ts::shareInvite) would silence the web LogBox on the resend flow too.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1233-1246 GET /families/preview: correctly filters `linked_user_id: None`, upper-cases the incoming code, returns only whitelisted fields (member_id/name/relationship/role/photo_url/color/is_child). Note: this endpoint requires auth (Depends(get_current_user)), which is fine because the onboarding screen only reaches it after registration.

server.py:1249-1279 POST /families/join: order of checks — already-in-family guard first, then invite lookup, then claim branch. `if not target or target.get('linked_user_id')` collapses two error cases into a single 400 (invalid id AND already-claimed) — matches the batch contract but a caller can't distinguish; consider splitting into 404 vs 409 if UX ever needs to show 'that profile was just claimed'.

server.py:998-1008 PATCH role: is_child is coerced from role only when body.role is set (`updates['is_child'] = body.role == 'child'`). Prevents drift when the admin toggles between adult and child. Admin-target 403 check runs after the invalid-role 400 which is correct.

frontend/app/onboarding/create-family.tsx:35-58 checkCode gracefully falls back to code-step on 404 and surfaces the server message via setError. Deep-link auto-fill (line 63-72) is stashed via storage.setItem('pendingInviteCode') from /join and consumed on mount — could not be exercised on web because Expo Router web doesn't fire /join?invite=… out of a fresh tab, but the code path is straightforward.
frontend/app/(tabs)/family.tsx:302 resend section is gated on `!actionMember.joined && invite` — matches backend contract and hides both WhatsApp/Share buttons the moment a member joins. Nice.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_batch24_preview_claim_role.py (new — 13 pytest cases: TestPreview x3, TestJoinClaim x4, TestRoleEdit x6)

success_rate.frontend: 100% — claim flow, role edit persistence, resend-hidden-for-joined, remove flow all verified

seed_data_creation: Per test-run: one throwaway admin+<uuid>@fam.com registered + POST /api/seed/demo (Sharma demo family with 5 members: 1 admin/joined + 4 pending), plus 1-3 throwaway joiners (joiner/badclaim/badid/newmem/junior) that join and are torn down via DELETE /api/auth/account. Admin cleanup purges the whole family so no residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For onboarding CLAIM UI on web preview: register the joiner via /api/auth/register FIRST, then log in through the UI (testIDs login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-btn) — the AsyncStorage-web layer stores auth in IndexedDB so injecting into window.localStorage does NOT persist auth. The onboarding claim step exposes testIDs 'claim-<member_id>' for each pending profile plus 'claim-new' for the fresh-member option, and 'join-family-submit' to finalise. Family-actions modal (Manage -> badge tap) exposes role-parent / role-child / role-adult chips, resend-whatsapp, resend-share, open-remove, confirm-remove-member, close-actions. Verifying chip selection visually is best done via getComputedStyle().borderColor: selected chips return rgb(255,107,107) while unselected are rgba(0,0,0,0). The Home screen still opens with an 'On this day 7 years ago' banner overlay after login — a neutral page.mouse.click(20,400) will dismiss it before tab navigation.
rca_of_issue: No new issues. Preview/claim/role-edit/resend all match spec across API and UI. The single web-only 'Share is not supported' LogBox on 'Share invite link' is a legacy pattern already documented in iteration_21.
